migrations.$comment: Time-critical asset wind-downs, where holding the old asset past a point loses funds. Each entry raises an app-wide popup for wallets holding one of its fromDenoms anywhere on Osmosis (bank balances, staked, in-locks, unclaimed rewards, or pooled). The popup can be snoozed (24h, 1h from escalateDate) but not dismissed for good. Matching is strict exact-denom. Ordinary alloy nudges belong to the alloyed-assets toast, not here.

id.$comment: Unique and stable. Snoozes are stored under it, so changing it re-shows the popup to everyone who snoozed.

fromDenoms.$comment: Minimal denoms being wound down, e.g. ibc/HASH or factory/... . Never symbols.

toDenom.$comment: Minimal denom the old assets convert into. Must be the canonical asset (variantGroupKey) of every fromDenom, or the popup won't offer the convert.

action.$comment: convert: swap each held variant into its canonical asset from the popup.

startDate.$comment: ISO 8601 date-time. The popup does not show before this.

escalateDate.$comment: Optional. From here the snooze drops to 1h and the popup reads as a warning.

deadline.$comment: Optional. Shown to users as a date, so only set it once the date is public. Without it there is no countdown and the copy should not name a date.

minFiatValueUsd.$comment: Optional. Holdings worth less than this in total don't raise the popup. Holdings that can't be priced always do.

enTitleOrLocalizationPath.$comment: English text or key into the localization block.

enBodyOrLocalizationPath.$comment: English text or key into the localization block. May contain {symbols} (the held old assets, e.g. "USDC, WBTC") and {deadline} placeholders.

enAfterDeadlineBodyOrLocalizationPath.$comment: Optional. Replaces the body once deadline has passed, e.g. to say what still works.

enTextOrLocalizationKey.$comment: English text or key into the localization block.

isExternal.$comment: External to Osmosis. Show disclaimer before linking out of app.

localization.$comment: Locale code -> object of localization keys to translated strings.
